newsitem.title: GERMANY: German women tell Jackson to beat it.
newsitem.headline: German women tell Jackson to beat it.

text.p: Michael Jackson's records are among the most popular in Germany but the eccentric American pop star wouldn't even make the charts as a prospective father, a poll published on Friday showed.
A survey of 1,006 German women by the Forsa research institute found not a single one would want to have Jackson's child.
The survey was done on behalf of a German television talk show. A studio audience burst out into applause when the poll results were announced.
Jackson married his pregnant girlfriend Debbie Rowe, a 37-year-old nurse, in Sydney last week.
